topic: Sync a local directory to an S3 bucket with safe deletes

defects.detail: The description begins with 'You can use this to synchronize', using second-person voice instead of third-person descriptive voice.

defects.location: README.md at root of skill directory
defects.detail: User-facing documentation (README.md with installation instructions) is included in the skill directory, which should contain only SKILL.md and referenced resources like scripts or documentation files.
The command sets 'max_concurrent_requests 23' with no explanation of why this specific number is chosen or how to determine the right value for a given environment.
All commands use the 'aws' CLI tool, but the skill never lists AWS CLI as a dependency or requirement. An agent following this skill would not know what binary needs to be installed.
